scenario: Series memory caps per LSER.10.10 — engine warns and emits metric on budget cross; no hard cap. Runtime-only spec point: memory accounting is integrator-side observability via the metric callback; no compile-time check applies. Compile pins basic series declaration; per-key memory growth + warning is runtime work that lands when the memory-budget metric is wired.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Float mutable

series Sensor.state:
    count sliding 10_s

rule trig:
    Sensor t where count(t.state) > 0
->
    log info "x"
